feed_page_default: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT p.* FROM posts p WHERE p.status = 'published' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 21
feed_page_keyset_deep: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT p.* FROM posts p WHERE p.status = 'published' AND (p.created_at < (SELECT created_at FROM posts ORDER BY created_at DESC OFFSET 1000 LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 21
feed_following_rpc: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM public.feed_following('__SUBJECT__'::uuid, 20, NULL, NULL, 0)
hidden_authors_mutes: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT muted_id FROM user_mutes WHERE muter_id = '__SUBJECT__' LIMIT 2000
hidden_authors_blocks_in: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT blocker_id FROM user_blocks WHERE blocked_id = '__SUBJECT__' LIMIT 2000
viewer_likes_for_page: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT post_id FROM post_likes WHERE profile_id = '__SUBJECT__' AND post_id IN (SELECT id FROM posts ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20)
likes_recount_one_post: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT count(*) FROM post_likes WHERE post_id = (SELECT post_id FROM post_likes GROUP BY post_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1)
notifications_unread_count: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = '__SUBJECT__' AND is_read = false
notifications_list_page: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE user_id = '__SUBJECT__' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 21
notifications_metadata_contains: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT id FROM notifications WHERE user_id = '__SUBJECT__' AND metadata @> '{"site_notice": true}'::jsonb LIMIT 50
conversation_list_rpc: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM public.get_conversation_list('__SUBJECT__'::uuid, 30, NULL)
follows_of_viewer_unbounded: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT following_id FROM follows WHERE follower_id = '__SUBJECT__' AND status = 'accepted'
followers_count_column_vs_count: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT count(*) FROM follows WHERE following_id = '__SUBJECT__' AND status = 'accepted'
live_now_participants_in: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT group_post_id, profile_id, status FROM group_post_participants WHERE profile_id IN (SELECT following_id FROM follows WHERE follower_id = '__SUBJECT__' AND status='accepted') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
cheers_count_one_kind: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT count(*) FROM live_cheers WHERE context_key = (SELECT context_key FROM live_cheers LIMIT 1) AND cheer = 'fire'
cheers_grouped_alternative: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT cheer, count(*) FROM live_cheers WHERE context_key = (SELECT context_key FROM live_cheers LIMIT 1) GROUP BY cheer
search_all_prefix: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM public.search_all('seed', NULL, 20, '{}'::uuid[], true)
search_people_rpc: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM public.search_people('see', '{}'::uuid[], true, 20)
media_counts_rpc: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM public.get_profile_media_counts('__SUBJECT__'::uuid, NULL)
public_profile_recent_posts: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT id FROM posts WHERE profile_id = '__SUBJECT__' AND status = 'published' AND visibility = 'public' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 24
rate_limit_hit_rpc: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT public.rate_limit_hit('explain:probe', 1000, 60)
search_where_only_count: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT count(*) FROM search_documents b WHERE (b.visibility='public') AND ((b.search_vector @@ public.search_prefix_tsquery('seed')) OR (b.title ILIKE '%seed%' OR b.subtitle ILIKE '%seed%' OR b.city ILIKE '%seed%' OR b.region ILIKE '%seed%' OR b.country ILIKE '%seed%'))
search_tsquery_only_count: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT count(*) FROM search_documents b WHERE b.visibility='public' AND b.search_vector @@ public.search_prefix_tsquery('seed')
search_ilike_only: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT entity_id FROM search_documents WHERE visibility = 'public' AND (title ILIKE '%eed%' OR subtitle ILIKE '%eed%') LIMIT 50
search_matched_with_case_columns: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT b.entity_id, CASE WHEN public.search_normalize(b.title) = 'seed' THEN 0 WHEN public.search_normalize(b.title) LIKE 'seed%' THEN 1 WHEN to_tsvector('simple', public.search_normalize(b.title)) @@ public.search_prefix_tsquery('seed') THEN 2 WHEN b.search_vector @@ public.search_prefix_tsquery('seed') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS tier, public.search_token_hits(to_tsvector('simple', public.search_normalize(b.title)), 'seed') AS name_hits, public.search_token_rank(b.search_vector, 'seed') AS score FROM search_documents b WHERE b.visibility='public' AND ((b.search_vector @@ public.search_prefix_tsquery('seed')) OR b.title ILIKE '%seed%' OR b.subtitle ILIKE '%seed%')
search_all_rare_term: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM public.search_all('seed-0042', NULL, 20, '{}'::uuid[], true)
search_all_two_letters: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM public.search_all('se', NULL, 20, '{}'::uuid[], true)
search_all_athletes_only: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM public.search_all('seed', ARRAY['athlete'], 20, '{}'::uuid[], true)
